note: v489: Statements fixes. Recording a payday deposit as a paycheck saved it but left the screen still showing that deposit as unmatched — the reconcile view now refreshes right away, so the month's mark updates on the spot. The background check that runs when you open Statements looks at one more month of context before marking last month, so a bill dated the 1st that the bank actually took on the 31st before no longer shows an amber dot that turns green the moment you tap it. And a failed bank pull can no longer swallow its own error message and skip the Reconnect prompt.
